# dsh-agency-agents-tonulls-en

English-language control command messages for the Agency Agents DSH bundle. Role names, skill descriptions, and source instructions remain mostly in English; the package does not guarantee that the model will answer in English.

## Installation

Install the English variant in the `web` profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins.git#tonulls&path:/dsh-[name]-tonulls/dsh-agency-agents-tonulls/packages/dsh-agency-agents-tonulls-en'
```

Replace `web` with your DSH profile name.

See the [English README](https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins/blob/tonulls/dsh-%5Bname%5D-tonulls/dsh-agency-agents-tonulls/.docs/en/README.md) for launch, verification, usage, updates, and removal. Install only one language variant per DSH profile.
